identity_check.method: For each core role, variation A and variation B differ in pitch and rhythm, not only in velocity, and B is not a uniform transpose of A. Variation A attack-time tuples are unique across the four kits, and variation A is not a uniform transpose of the same role in another kit. Within a kit, bass, keys, lead, and counterline are not copies or uniform transposes of each other.
